title: Harness Policy Distillation: Aligning Agent Policies with Runtime Semantics

paragraphs.en: Deploying a general-purpose model as an agent means running it inside a product-specific runtime harness that decides which actions are executable, how state advances, and when the loop may terminate. Ordinary trajectory supervision shows which action was taken but leaves the runtime semantics behind that action implicit. We introduce Harness Policy Distillation ( HPD ), which makes these runtime control semantics an explicit training target alongside actions to align the harness policy. HPD replays reference trajectories through the harness to recover the runtime semantics that are implicit in ordinary trajectory data, and represents them as control documents at each model-call boundary. These documents provide privileged information for a teacher to generate actions, while harness verification ensures that the resulting targets are executable under the runtime contract. We jointly trains a shared model on the runtime semantics recovered from control-state privileged information and native history, thereby internalizing these semantics into the model policy. At deployment, the trained model uses the original harness interface without requiring the control document or any additional supplement. On TRAJECT-Bench with the Pi harness, Qwen3-8B trained with HPD reaches 22.98% autonomous task success and 49.23% runtime compliance, against 3.09% and 19.90% for the unadapted model. Harness-verified teacher actions substantially improve the native deployment policy, while joint control-state supervision provides further gains in task completion and runtime compliance. HPD turns executable runtime semantics into dense supervision for learning harness-compatible actions at each decision boundary.

paragraphs.en: A general-purpose model becomes a deployed agent only inside a product-specific runtime harness. The harness serializes visible history, exposes an approved action interface, enforces permissions and workflow stages, inserts tool observations, schedules subsequent model calls, and defines valid termination ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) . For an organization adapting a model to its own product, the relevant target is therefore not task competence or tool syntax alone, but a harness-bound policy whose actions remain executable under that product’s runtime contract.
paragraphs.zh: 通用模型只有在特定产品的运行时框架内，才会成为一个部署的智能体。 该框架会序列化可见的历史记录、暴露经批准的操作接口、强制执行权限和工作流阶段、插入工具观察结果、安排后续模型调用，并定义有效的终止条件（Yang et al., 2024；Wang et al., 2025）。 因此，对于将模型适配到自身产品的组织而言，相关目标并非仅仅是任务能力或工具语法，而是与框架绑定的策略，其操作必须在该产品的运行时合同下保持可执行性。

paragraphs.en: Most post-training objectives supervise behavior without separately specifying the runtime control state on which that behavior depends. Demonstration and trajectory training maximize the likelihood of reference actions conditioned on observed histories, leaving the control state implicit in the mapping from history to action. Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) increases the relative likelihood of preferred outputs ( Rafailov et al., 2023 ) ; Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) optimizes expected return from executable checks ( Shao et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2025 ) , leaving the policy to infer reward-relevant control state through credit assignment. On-policy distillation (OPD) matches teacher behavior at student-generated prefixes ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ) , improving the coverage of states at which supervision is supplied while leaving the teacher’s action distribution as the direct target. These objectives can learn runtime-sensitive behavior, but their standard forms leave the underlying control state to be inferred through action, preference, reward, or teacher supervision.
paragraphs.zh: 大多数训练后目标都会对行为进行监督，但并未单独明确该行为所依赖的运行时控制状态。 演示和轨迹训练会最大化参考动作在给定观察历史条件下的概率，而将控制状态隐含在从历史到动作的映射中。 直接偏好优化（DPO）会提升偏好输出的相对概率（Rafailov 等人，2023）；结合可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）则会通过可执行检查来优化期望回报（Shao 等人，2024；Guo 等人，2025），而策略则需通过信用分配来推断与奖励相关的控制状态。 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）会在学生模型生成的前缀上匹配教师模型的行为（Agarwal 等人，2024），从而扩大监督覆盖的状态范围，同时仍将教师模型的动作分布作为直接目标。 这些目标能够学习对运行时敏感的行为，但其标准形式仍要求通过动作、偏好、奖励或教师监督来推断底层的控制状态。

paragraphs.en: Within an agent, the model selects actions while the harness governs their execution. We distinguish two sources of policy mismatch between them. Supervision mismatch arises when the histories used for supervision differ from those generated by the agent’s own rollout: a model may fit reference actions yet struggle to continue once its own actions lead to histories poorly covered during training ( Ross et al., 2011 ; Bengio et al., 2015 ) . Runtime-state mismatch arises when the model policy fails to reflect the harness’s current execution requirements. Even on a valid reference history, action labels leave implicit which obligations remain and whether termination is allowed; the model may therefore repeat completed work or stop while required work is still pending. The two problems interact through the closed loop: each action changes the successor state and hence the context of the next decision. Improving the conditional policy at replayed boundaries is therefore a concrete training target, while autonomous task completion measures its effect across an entire execution. Because each action changes the next runtime state and model context, a local error can affect later decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 在智能体内部，模型选择动作，而执行框架则管理这些动作的执行。 我们区分两者之间策略失配的两个来源。 当用于监督的历史与智能体自身展开生成的历史不同时，就会出现监督失配：模型可能能够拟合参考动作，但一旦其自身动作导致训练期间覆盖不足的历史时，就可能难以继续执行（Ross et al., 2011；Bengio et al., 2015）。 当模型策略未能反映执行框架当前的执行需求时，就会出现运行时状态失配。 即使在有效的参考历史中，动作标签也隐含着哪些义务尚未完成以及是否允许终止；因此，模型可能会重复已完成的工作，或在仍有必要工作未完成时就停止执行。 这两个问题通过闭环相互作用：每个动作都会改变后续状态，从而改变下一次决策的上下文。 因此，在重播边界上改进条件策略是一个具体的训练目标，而自主任务完成度则衡量其在整个执行过程中的效果。 由于每个动作都会改变下一个运行时状态和模型上下文，局部错误可能会影响后续的决策。

paragraphs.en: The harness provides a complementary source of supervision: its execution history and runtime bookkeeping identify the obligations and lifecycle conditions that govern the next action. For example, tool availability alone does not indicate whether the corresponding obligation has already been completed. Learning the next action from a reference trajectory leaves this distinction implicit; explicitly supervising the boundary’s control state makes it a prediction. We therefore target this policy mismatch with explicit control-state and action supervision at replayed boundaries, and evaluate its effect through autonomous task completion.
paragraphs.zh: 该约束机制提供了补充的监督来源：其执行历史和运行时记录能够识别出决定下一步行动的义务和生命周期条件。 例如，仅凭工具是否可用，无法判断相应的义务是否已经完成。 从参考轨迹中学习下一步行动会使这种区别保持隐式；而明确监督边界的控制状态则能将其转化为预测。 因此，我们在重播边界处通过明确的控制状态和行动监督来针对这种策略不匹配问题，并通过自主任务完成来评估其效果。

paragraphs.en: To make this connection learnable, we propose Harness Policy Distillation (HPD) , which couples explicit control-state supervision with harness-verified action targets to align the model policy with the runtime semantics governing execution. At each replayed boundary, HPD compiles runtime observations and reference-derived control annotations into a privileged control document. This document guides a sampling model to propose actions, while harness verification restricts the training targets to candidates consistent with the execution and reference-control requirements. Recorded actions advance replay while selected candidates provide training targets, preserving the reference histories on which the paired supervision is defined.

paragraphs.en: To internalize these control semantics without requiring the document during autonomous execution, HPD jointly trains three views of one shared model. Runtime uses the compiled document as a target for control-state prediction from native history; Injected teaches action selection with these conditions made explicit. Harness-Replay trains the same verified action from native context alone, so action learning also matches the input available at deployment. Together, these views connect explicit control supervision to native action selection. The trained model acts through the original harness without an external control document or an additional model call (Figure 1).

sents.en: Together, these views connect explicit control supervision to native action selection.
sents.zh: 这些视图共同将显式的控制监督与原始动作选择连接起来。

sents.en: The trained model acts through the original harness without an external control document or an additional model call (Figure 1).

paragraphs.en: Policies trained by behavior cloning run on histories induced by their own actions, motivating interactive imitation and scheduled sampling ( Ross et al., 2011 ; Bengio et al., 2015 ) . Sequence models instead fit state–action trajectories directly ( Chen et al., 2021 ; Janner et al., 2021 ) , while knowledge distillation and language-model post-training transfer teacher sequences, demonstrations, or preferences ( Hinton et al., 2015 ; Kim & Rush, 2016 ; Ouyang et al., 2022 ; Rafailov et al., 2023 ) . On-policy distillation and agentic RL move supervision or reward toward student-generated prefixes ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ; Shao et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2025 ) . These methods primarily change the action target, reward, or visited occupancy; HPD instead adds runtime facts and reference-derived control labels as supervised targets at replayed decision boundaries.
paragraphs.zh: 通过行为克隆训练的策略运行在由其自身动作引发的历史数据上，从而促成了交互式模仿和计划采样（Ross 等，2011；Bengio 等，2015）。 序列模型则直接拟合状态–动作轨迹（Chen 等，2021；Janner 等，2021），而知识蒸馏和语言模型后训练转移方法则将教师序列、演示或偏好作为输入（Hinton 等，2015；Kim & Rush，2016；Ouyang 等，2022；Rafailov 等，2023）。 在线策略蒸馏和智能体强化学习将监督或奖励转向由学生模型生成的前缀（Agarwal 等，2024；Shao 等，2024；Guo 等，2025）。 这些方法主要改变动作目标、奖励或访问频率；而 HPD 方法则在重播决策边界处，将运行时事实和参考来源的控制标签作为监督目标添加进来。

paragraphs.en: Learning using privileged information introduces training-time variables that need not be available at inference ( Vapnik & Vashist, 2009 ; Lopez-Paz et al., 2016 ) . In self-distillation, privileged context lets a model supervise its counterpart without that context ( Zhao et al., 2026a ) . π \pi -Distill jointly trains a privileged-information-conditioned teacher and a student without that information using shared model parameters in multi-turn agentic environments ( Penaloza et al., 2026 ) . Process supervision identifies where a multistep solution becomes invalid ( Uesato et al., 2022 ; Lightman et al., 2024 ) . Training with Harnesses uses a harness-augmented current model as an on-policy self-teacher to internalize reasoning workflows ( Zhao et al., 2026b ) . HPD pairs replay-derived control documents with actions selected by harness verification at the same decision boundary.
paragraphs.zh: 使用特权信息进行学习会在训练阶段引入推理阶段未必可用的变量（Vapnik & Vashist, 2009；Lopez-Paz 等，2016）。 在自蒸馏中，特权上下文使模型能够在没有该上下文的情况下对其对应模型进行监督（Zhao 等，2026a）。π \pi-蒸馏通过在多轮智能体环境中共享模型参数，联合训练一个以特权信息为条件的教师模型和一个不依赖该信息的学生模型（Penaloza 等，2026）。 过程监督能够识别多步骤解决方案在何处变得无效（Uesato 等，2022；Lightman 等，2024）。 使用“Harness”的训练方法将经过 Harness 增强的当前模型用作在线策略自教师，以内化推理工作流程（Zhao 等，2026b）。 HPD 将来自重放的控制文档与 Harness 验证在同一决策边界上选择的操作进行配对。

paragraphs.en: ReAct and tool-learning methods interleave language-model generation with environment actions or construct tool-use supervision ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Schick et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2023 ; Qin et al., 2024 ) . Interactive benchmarks make stateful execution central ( Shridhar et al., 2021 ; Yao et al., 2022 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Mialon et al., 2024 ; Jimenez et al., 2024 ) . SWE-agent and OpenHands further show that the agent interface, event stream, sandbox, and stopping rules are part of the deployed system ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) . Evaluation work separates final task completion from intermediate progress and policy compliance ( Ma et al., 2024 ; Yao et al., 2025 ; Lu et al., 2025 ) . HPD uses this runtime lifecycle as a supervised object rather than treating it only as an external evaluator.
paragraphs.zh: ReAct 和工具学习方法将语言模型生成与环境动作交替进行，或构建工具使用监督机制（Yao 等，2023；Schick 等，2023；Yang 等，2023；Qin 等，2024）。 交互式基准测试使状态化执行成为核心（Shridhar 等，2021；Yao 等，2022；Zhou 等，2024；Liu 等，2024；Mialon 等，2024；Jimenez 等，2024）。 SWE-agent 和 OpenHands 进一步表明，智能体接口、事件流、沙盒和停止规则都是部署系统的一部分（Yang 等，2024；Wang 等，2025）。 评估工作将最终任务完成与中间进展及策略合规性区分开来（Ma 等，2024；Yao 等，2025；Lu 等，2025）。 HPD 将这一运行时生命周期作为受监督对象来使用，而不仅仅将其视为外部评估器。

paragraphs.en: HPD addresses this conditional-target gap by constructing paired control and action supervision at replayed reference boundaries (Figure 1 ). Reference actions advance the harness, while runtime observations and reference annotations are compiled into a privileged control document at each boundary. The frozen base model conditions on this document to propose actions, from which verification and near-reference selection produce the training target. The resulting context–document–action triples train one shared model through native-context action prediction, document-conditioned action prediction, and control-document reconstruction. At deployment, the model predicts actions directly from the native context.
paragraphs.zh: HPD 通过在重播的参考边界处构建成对的控制与动作监督，来解决这一条件-目标之间的差距（图 1）。 参考动作推动 harness 向前推进，而运行时观察结果和参考标注则在每个边界处被整合成一份特权控制文档。 冻结的基础模型基于这份文档提出动作，随后通过验证和选择接近参考的动作来生成训练目标。 由此产生的上下文-文档-动作三元组通过原生上下文动作预测、文档条件化动作预测以及控制文档重建，对单一共享模型进行训练。 在部署阶段，该模型直接从原生上下文中预测动作。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate Qwen3-8B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) with LoRA adaptation ( Hu et al., 2022 ) on 583 held-out TRAJECT-Bench tasks ( He et al., 2026 ) . Table 1 compares HPD with the base model and supervised, preference, reinforcement-learning, and distillation baselines. We report task success (TS), final-answer F1, gold-history action accuracy (Action-Acc), reference-prefix success (Step-SR), runtime compliance (RC), and exact-path success (Exact), all produced by pi-runtime . We then test component and schedule effects, boundary behavior, adaptation across models and harnesses, and transfer to a new task collection. Appendices C and E specify the training, baseline implementations, seed study, and metric definitions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 583 个预留的 TRAJECT-Bench 任务（He et al., 2026）上，使用 LoRA 适配方法（Hu et al., 2022）对 Qwen3-8B（Yang et al., 2025）进行了评估。 表 1 比较了 HPD 与基础模型，以及监督学习、偏好学习、强化学习和蒸馏等基线模型。 我们报告了任务成功度（TS）、最终答案的 F1 分数、黄金历史动作准确率（Action-Acc）、参考前缀成功率（Step-SR）、运行时合规性（RC）和精确路径成功率（Exact），这些指标均由 pi-runtime 生成。 接着，我们测试了组件和调度方案的影响、边界行为、跨模型和工具集的适配能力，以及向新任务集合的迁移效果。 附录 C 和 E 详细说明了训练过程、基线模型实现、种子研究以及指标定义。

paragraphs.en: Reference supervision: SFT and DPO. SFT raises RC from 19.90 to 55.92 and Step-SR from 26.45 to 47.20, yet lowers TS from 3.09 to 2.06 and F1 from 26.82 to 2.40. Fitting recorded gold actions improves reference-path metrics here without preserving answer quality or task completion under Pi deployment, illustrating the mismatch introduced in the Introduction. DPO achieves the best Action-Acc alongside 11.12 Step-SR and 7.20 TS. Its advantage is local reference-action ranking; its rollout follows the reference prefix less often. RC separately measures compliance with the execution contract. Together, these metrics distinguish fitting the next reference action, maintaining its reference path, and completing an executable task.
paragraphs.zh: 参考监督：SFT 和 DPO。 SFT 将 RC 从 19.90 提升至 55.92，将 Step-SR 从 26.45 提升至 47.20，但使 TS 从 3.09 降至 2.06，F1 从 26.82 降至 2.40。 在 Pi 部署中，拟合已记录的黄金动作虽然提升了参考路径指标，却未能保留答案质量或任务完成度，这说明了引言中指出的不匹配问题。 DPO 实现了最高的 Action-Acc，同时 Step-SR 为 11.12，TS 为 7.20。 其优势在于对参考动作的局部排序；但在展开过程中，它较少遵循参考前缀。 RC 单独衡量对执行合同的遵守程度。 这些指标共同区分了拟合下一个参考动作、维持其参考路径以及完成可执行任务这三个不同目标。

paragraphs.en: Harness-verified replay and runtime semantics. HPD-T uses the same document-conditioned, verifier-selected teacher as Full HPD, but trains only the native replay-action view. Relative to OPD, it gains 4.97 TS points and 1.54 Exact points while its mean F1 is slightly lower (39.96 versus 41.04). The verified-target and native-action pipeline thus improves closed-loop completion. Adding I/R training views raises TS by another 2.40 points, Step-SR by 4.54 points, and Exact by 3.09 points. The runtime semantics injection and control-document views contribute to this second gain.
paragraphs.zh: 经过 Harness 验证的重播和运行时语义。 HPD-T 使用与 Full HPD 相同的文档条件化、由验证器选择的教师模型，但仅训练原生重播-动作视图。 与 OPD 相比，其 TS 分数提升了 4.97 分，Exact 分数提升了 1.54 分，但平均 F1 略低（39.96 对比 41.04）。 因此，经过验证的目标和原生动作的管道能够提升闭环完成率。 添加 I/R 训练视图使 TS 再提升 2.40 分，Step-SR 提升 4.54 分，Exact 提升 3.09 分。 运行时语义注入和控制文档视图促成了这一第二阶段的提升。

sents.en: Harness-verified replay and runtime semantics.

sents.en: HPD-T uses the same document-conditioned, verifier-selected teacher as Full HPD, but trains only the native replay-action view.
sents.zh: HPD-T 使用与 Full HPD 相同的文档条件化、由验证器选择的教师模型，但仅训练原生重播-动作视图。

sents.en: Relative to OPD, it gains 4.97 TS points and 1.54 Exact points while its mean F1 is slightly lower (39.96 versus 41.04).
sents.zh: 与 OPD 相比，其 TS 分数提升了 4.97 分，Exact 分数提升了 1.54 分，但平均 F1 略低（39.96 对比 41.04）。

sents.en: The verified-target and native-action pipeline thus improves closed-loop completion.
sents.zh: 因此，经过验证的目标和原生动作的管道能够提升闭环完成率。

sents.en: Adding I/R training views raises TS by another 2.40 points, Step-SR by 4.54 points, and Exact by 3.09 points.
sents.zh: 添加 I/R 训练视图使 TS 再提升 2.40 分，Step-SR 提升 4.54 分，Exact 提升 3.09 分。

sents.en: The runtime semantics injection and control-document views contribute to this second gain.
sents.zh: 运行时语义注入和控制文档视图促成了这一第二阶段的提升。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the TRAJECT-Bench-trained checkpoints on 92 BFCL v4 cases ( Patil et al., 2025 ) without BFCL-specific training. BFCL supplies new tasks and default tool execution; the Pi agent, checkpoints, and model-side settings remain fixed (Appendix C.6 ). Full HPD reaches 21.74 TS, and 48.12 Step-SR versus Base’s 13.04, and 42.03. HPD-T reaches 13.04 TS, and 46.16 Step-SR: adding I/R raises TS by 8.70 and Step-SR by 1.96 points.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在没有进行 BFCL 特定训练的情况下，使用 92 个 BFCL v4 案例（Patil 等人，2025）评估了通过 TRAJECT-Bench 训练的检查点。 BFCL 提供了新任务和默认工具执行方式；Pi 智能体、检查点和模型侧的设置保持不变（附录 C.6）。 完整 HPD 的 TS 达到 21.74，Step-SR 为 48.12，而 Base 的对应数值分别为 13.04 和 42.03。 HPD-T 的 TS 达到 13.04，Step-SR 为 46.16：添加 I/R 后，TS 增加了 8.70 分，Step-SR 增加了 1.96 分。

paragraphs.en: HPD-T improves answer overlap and prefix execution over Base but not task completion. On these new tasks, Full HPD’s completion gain is consistent with I/R connecting replay actions to Pi’s pending obligations and termination beyond source-task patterns. When the test tasks extend beyond the range of trajectories encountered during training, the performance gains of HPD-T drop significantly; in contrast, HPD reinforces the alignment of the harness policy—rather than overfitting to a specific task distribution—by leveraging runtime semantic training (I/R), which accounts for its superior generalization capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: HPD-T 在答案重叠率和前缀执行方面优于 Base，但在任务完成度上并无提升。 在这些新任务中，完整 HPD 的完成度提升与 I/R 将重播动作连接到 Pi 的待办义务以及超越源任务模式的终止机制保持一致。 当测试任务超出训练期间所遇到的轨迹范围时，HPD-T 的性能提升会显著下降；相比之下，HPD 通过利用运行时语义训练（I/R），强化了约束策略的一致性，而非对特定任务分布过度拟合，这解释了其更出色的泛化能力。

paragraphs.en: Using HPD-T as the anchor, the two-view rows distinguish the contributions of I and R before combining all three views. paragraphs.en: At the same replayed decision boundaries, we examine three aspects of action formation: confidence in the reference control entry, uncertainty over the reference-conditioned continuation, and validity of the action generated without a reference prefix. Figure 3 compares Base, SFT, GRPO, and HPD; Appendix E.1 defines the measurements.
paragraphs.zh: 在相同的重播决策边界上，我们考察了动作形成的三个方面：对参考控制条目的置信度、参考条件化延续的不确定性，以及在没有参考前缀的情况下生成的动作的有效性。 图 3 比较了 Base、SFT、GRPO 和 HPD；附录 E.1 定义了相关测量指标。

paragraphs.en: In panel (a), HPD assigns a mean probability of 0.9962 to the reference control entry, compared with 0.6242 for Base, 0.5087 for GRPO, and 0.1296 for SFT. This is alignment with the reference entry at a supplied boundary; SFT can score higher on rollout compliance while assigning less probability to that particular entry.

paragraphs.en: Panel (b) examines the distribution of continuation entropy across those boundaries. SFT’s density shifts toward higher entropy and loses much of the low-entropy mass visible for Base. HPD and GRPO retain substantial overlap with Base, even as HPD’s reference control-entry confidence rises sharply. paragraphs.en: Figure 4 shows higher TS and F1 across all evaluated architectures and harnesses after separate adaptation. Each within-study Base–HPD pair measures the effect of applying the same construction and training procedure to that configuration. Llama3-8B gains 20.07 TS points (Base TS: 0), while Gemma4-12B ( Gemma Team et al., 2026 ) gains 16.47 points and Qwen3-30B-A3B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) gains 12.69 points. Separate adapters for ReAct, Compiler, and OpenCode gain 9.44–18.35 TS points across different scheduling, dependency, and permission semantics. Each adaptation rebuilds replay, control documents, and verification for its harness while retaining the T/I/R objective and native-runtime deployment. The two axes stress different parts of HPD: the backbone comparison changes the policy under Pi, whereas the harness comparison changes the execution contract under Qwen3-8B. In each setting, replay and verification construct compatible action targets, and T/I/R connects them to native execution. The consistent gains support portability of this construction across both model and runtime changes.
paragraphs.zh: 图4显示，在单独适配后，所有评估过的架构和测试框架中，TS和F1指标均有所提升。 每项研究中的每个Base–HPD配对，用于衡量将相同的构建和训练流程应用于该配置所产生的效果。 Llama3-8B获得了20.07个TS积分（Base TS：0），而Gemma4-12B（Gemma团队等，2026）获得了16.47个积分，Qwen3-30B-A3B（Yang等，2025）获得了12.69个积分。 针对ReAct、Compiler和OpenCode的独立适配器，在不同调度、依赖和权限语义下，分别获得了9.44至18.35个TS积分。 每次适配都会为对应的测试框架重新构建重播、控制文档和验证机制，同时保留T/I/R目标以及原生运行时部署方式。 这两个坐标轴强调了HPD的不同方面：骨干模型比较改变了Pi下的策略，而测试框架比较则改变了Qwen3-8B下的执行契约。 在每种设置中，重播和验证机制都会构建兼容的动作目标，而T/I/R则将其与原生执行连接起来。 这些一致的增益表明，该构建方法在模型和运行时发生变化时均具备良好的可移植性。

paragraphs.en: Our study addresses policy mismatch between the model and harness within an agent by targeting runtime-state mismatch . It teaches the model both what to do and which execution conditions to account for. HPD turns executable runtime contracts into verified action targets and explicit control supervision and three shared-parameter views T, I, R, connect them to the native deployment policy. On TRAJECT-Bench with Pi, HPD reaches 22.98 task success versus OPD’s 15.61 at nearly equal aggregate F1. HPD-T already benefits from verified action supervision, while joint control-state training further improves completion. This benefit extends to new tasks: on 92 BFCL v4 cases without retraining, Full HPD reaches 21.74% task success versus HPD-T’s 13.04%. Separate adaptations improve performance across model backbones and harnesses. Deployment retains a single model and the existing agent interface, without an external control document. Together, these results support aligning agent policies not only with task actions, but also with the runtime semantics that govern execution.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究通过针对运行时状态的不匹配，解决了智能体内部模型与执行器之间的策略不匹配问题。 它同时教会了模型该做什么以及需要考虑哪些执行条件。 HPD将可执行的运行时合同转化为经过验证的动作目标、明确的控制监督以及三个共享参数视图 T、I、R，并将它们连接到原生部署策略中。 在 TRAJECT-Bench 上使用 Pi 时，HPD 的任务成功率达到了 22.98%，而 OPD 为 15.61%，且两者的综合 F1 值几乎相等。 HPD-T 已经受益于经过验证的动作监督，而联合控制与状态训练则进一步提升了任务完成度。 这种优势也延伸到了新任务中：在无需重新训练的 92 个 BFCL v4 案例中，完整 HPD 的任务成功率为 21.74%，而 HPD-T 为 13.04%。 独立的适配方法能够提升不同模型基座和执行器的性能。 部署过程保留了单个模型和现有的智能体接口，无需外部控制文档。 综合来看，这些结果支持将智能体策略不仅与任务动作对齐，还与支配执行的运行时语义对齐。

paragraphs.en: Replay requires five conditions: each recorded action must be executable under the target harness; the pre-action runtime prefix must be available at every model-call boundary; observed fields must be computed only from that prefix; privileged control annotations must declare their replay provenance; and the successor transition must be verifiable. The recorded action is one executable witness that reconstructs the reference path. The selected verified model candidate supplies the action-training target. At each boundary, AutoProbe compiles the control document, the frozen base model is queried with the document-injected context, and candidate actions are checked by the harness verifier. The main replay state is then advanced with the recorded action, while recorded tool observations are consumed through a per-tool queue stored in runtime state. Unconsumed future observations remain an execution fixture and are not exposed to the model-visible prefix. The construction stores the selected verified hard target rather than teacher logits.

paragraphs.en: For Pi, the probe is attached to the real provider request inside the agent loop. When the callback fires, the current action has not yet been generated, whereas all prior assistant actions, tool results, errors, and user steering have already been inserted and the previous turn preparation has completed. paragraphs.en: The compiler first normalizes harness-visible objects into stable fields. It retains message roles and text, prior tool names and arguments, tool-result content and error status, available tool schemas, and execution modes, while discarding call identifiers, timestamps, usage metadata, streaming events, and runtime function objects. From this pre-action snapshot it deterministically computes observational fields such as lifecycle position, issued calls, and successful or failed tools. A second replay-ledger stage uses the reference stage to label completed and pending recorded requirements. Witness-derived fields use the current recorded action to label the ready frontier and the next continue/final decision. Each field class consequently has a distinct supervisory role: observed fields describe the pre-action runtime, replay-ledger fields identify progress along the reference, and witness-derived fields annotate the next recorded control decision. The complete document is a privileged target. Runtime learns its conditional prediction from the native context, while Injected receives its explicit action hints. This provenance connects the source of each label to its use in training: the reference supplies the supervised control labels, the injected view learns the associated action, and the native and runtime views learn their conditionals from deployment history.

paragraphs.en: Full HPD has the highest TS and Step-SR (21.74 and 48.12), whereas HPD-T has the highest F1 (26.12). HPD-T matches Base’s 13.04 TS but exceeds its F1 and Step-SR by 6.66 and 4.13 points. Relative to HPD-T, Full HPD gains 8.70 TS and 1.96 Step-SR points while losing 2.83 F1 points. T-only replay thus transfers answer overlap and prefix execution without improving completed-task coverage on this collection; the additional I/R views are associated with the completion gain. OPD and DPO tie for the highest external-baseline TS at 17.39. OPD has the strongest external-baseline F1 and Step-SR (21.50 and 45.87); Full HPD exceeds it by 4.35, 1.79, and 2.25 points, respectively. OPSD reaches 8.70 TS, 16.89 F1, and 44.06 Step-SR, improving reference-prefix execution over Base without improving task completion. DPO improves TS over Base but lowers F1 and Step-SR; SFT and GRPO fall below Base on all three metrics. These differences suggest that verified replay alone can transfer partial execution behavior, while I/R better connects those actions to the runtime control state required for completion on new tasks.
